summary: Frontend-only testing of: (1) Team page typo fix, (2) new Google Translate LanguageSwitcher + cookie-consent gating integration. Team fix confirmed correct. LanguageSwitcher UI/UX, consent-gating, dropdown, notranslate protection, and cookie-modal sync all work correctly. Found 2 real integration bugs (not the documented 'Google servers blocked' environment caveat - translation DOES visually render in this env) plus 1 CSS bug.

ui_bugs.issue: Google's default translate banner bar (top strip: 'Google | Translated to: X ▼ | Show original | Options') is NOT hidden and remains fully visible, pushing page content down when a non-English language is active. The CSS in index.css targets '.goog-te-banner-frame' but the actual iframe rendered by Google in this app has class 'VIpgJd-ZVi9od-ORHb-OEVmcd skiptranslate' (id ':1.container') - a mismatch, so the hide rule never applies. Confirmed visually in screenshots (banner overlaps navbar).

integration_issues.flow: Reload persistence of chosen language (LanguageSwitcher.jsx useEffect auto-apply on mount)
integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: After selecting French and reloading, the page comes back translated into Chinese (zh-CN), NOT French, even though localStorage 'xo_language' correctly still reads 'fr' and the switcher button still shows 'FR'. Confirmed with a fully clean browser (cookies + localStorage cleared) so it isn't leftover state. Google's own 'googtrans' cookie ends up as '/en/zh-CN' after reload despite our applyLanguage('fr') retry loop running on mount. Manually re-opening the dropdown and re-clicking French immediately fixes it correctly (page renders proper French text, googtrans cookie becomes /en/fr) - proving the core selectLanguage()/applyLanguage() mechanism itself works fine; the bug is specific to the auto-restore-on-mount path racing against Google's own default/geo-based translation behavior on fresh widget init. Root cause likely: TranslateElement re-initializes on every reload and Google applies its own default target before our retry loop's dispatched 'change' event takes effect, or the retry loop finishes before Google's own init settles.

integration_issues.flow: Immediate (same-session, no reload) visual translation after picking a language from the dropdown
integration_issues.issue: Selecting French from the dropdown (without a subsequent reload) correctly fires script request to translate.google.com, sets xo_consent_v1.translation=true, xo_language='fr', and button shows 'FR' - but the page's VISIBLE TEXT does NOT actually change to French in that same session (stays in English). No 'googtrans' cookie is set at that point either. Only after a full page reload does translation start rendering (to the wrong language, per bug above). Per the review's documented caveat this could be environment-dependent Google-server latency, but since translation DOES work later (proven when manually re-selecting), this suggests our retry loop's dispatched change event isn't being honored by Google in the very first widget init before a reload happens.

action_items: Fix CSS selector in index.css to match the actual Google banner iframe class ('skiptranslate' + dynamically generated classes like 'VIpgJd-ZVi9od-ORHb-OEVmcd') rather than the outdated '.goog-te-banner-frame' class name, or use a more robust approach (e.g. hide any iframe whose src is the translate frame, or use '#\:1\.container' / attribute-based selector, or CSS like `.skiptranslate iframe { display: none !important; }` combined with body top reset).

Investigate and fix the auto-apply-on-mount race: on page load, applyLanguage(savedLanguage) should reliably restore the exact previously chosen language, not fall back to a different Google-default language. Consider explicitly setting the 'googtrans' cookie directly (document.cookie = 'googtrans=/en/' + code) before/alongside driving the hidden select, and/or increasing the settle delay before the first selectLanguage attempt after TranslateElement construction, and/or verifying combo.value actually stuck (re-check after a short delay and re-apply if it drifted).

Investigate why translation doesn't visually render in the very first same-session selection immediately after mounting the widget (works fine on manual re-selection after reload) - likely same root cause as above (race between our select and Google's own init).
critical_code_review_comments: LanguageSwitcher.jsx / googleTranslate.js: selectLanguage()'s retry-loop assumes the combo existing means the selection will register successfully; in practice Google's widget can silently ignore/overwrite an early selection during its own init sequence. A verification step (re-check combo.value after the change event fires, retry if mismatched) would make this considerably more robust.

index.css: the Google banner-hiding CSS selector is stale/incorrect for the Google Translate script version actually loading - should be validated against the live DOM rather than assumed from documentation, since Google's internal class names (VIpgJd-ZVi9od-*) are not the documented .goog-te-banner-frame in this instance.

Good practice observed: 'notranslate' class correctly applied to LanguageSwitcher's own button/dropdown - confirmed the button always renders 'EN'/'FR' correctly and is never mangled by Google's translation, even while other page text is actively translated.

Good practice observed: getConsent()/setConsentCategory() single-source-of-truth design in CookieConsent.jsx works correctly - cookie preferences modal's Translation toggle correctly reflects state set from the navbar LanguageSwitcher and vice versa, via the 'xo:consent-updated' CustomEvent.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth involved in this feature
context_for_next_testing_agent: Team page typo fix (David Meltzer, OD, MBA) verified correct - no further action needed there. LanguageSwitcher UI (globe pill, dropdown with 9 languages, outside-click-to-close, notranslate protection) all verified working on desktop. Consent-gating (picking non-English flips xo_consent_v1.translation=true, English restore, cookie-modal toggle sync in both directions) all verified working. Two real bugs found in the Google Translate INTEGRATION itself (not blocked-network environment issue, since translation clearly CAN render - confirmed via manual re-selection producing correct French text): (1) CSS selector to hide Google's own banner bar is stale/wrong, banner visibly shows at top of page when translated; (2) auto-restoring a saved language on page reload picks the wrong language (zh-CN observed) instead of the saved one (fr), while manual re-selection from the dropdown immediately corrects it. Did not test mobile viewport for LanguageSwitcher specifically (desktop only) - could be checked by next agent if needed. All console checks across home/team/cookie-policy/privacy-policy pages were clean (no errors).
